sentences: I measure the length and width of each tile before I place it on the floor.
I check the edges of the tiles for chips or cracks after they arrive from the supplier.
I spread adhesive on the wall with a notched trowel before setting the first tile.
I use plastic spacers between tiles to keep the grout lines even.
I cut a tile with a wet saw to fit around the bathroom plumbing.
I mix grout powder with water in a bucket until it reaches a peanut butter consistency.
I press the tile into the mortar and twist it slightly to ensure full coverage.
I wipe excess grout off the tile surface with a damp sponge after it sets.
I seal the grout lines with a penetrating sealer to prevent staining.
I tap the tile with a rubber mallet to check for hollow spots.
I remove the old broken tile from the kitchen backsplash with a chisel.
I stack the leftover tiles in the garage for future repair jobs.
I order three boxes of ceramic tiles from the hardware store website.
I deliver the tiles to the job site in the bed of my pickup truck.
I measure the diagonal of the room to determine the layout of the tiles.
I apply a waterproof membrane under the tiles in the shower area.
I scribe the tile to the contour of the door frame using a compass.
I polish the marble tile with a buffing pad after installation is complete.
I count the number of tiles needed for the entire floor area.
I replace the cracked tile in the hallway with a spare from the closet.
